itemList.description: Operation & Maintainance of Multi Village Water Supply Scheme to B G Pura & Other 56 Villages in MalavalliTaluk of Mandya District for the Year of  2026-27. The work includes providing sufficient technical staff, valve man, operators, Electrician and others who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials chemicals required for operation for Jack wells /WTP/pipeline repair works. Regular Maintenance of civil structures like well approach bridge Aerator settling tank, Raw water balancing tank, S.S.F. Pure water sump, pump house and all other civil structures. The maintanance consists of all kinds of repairs to damaged structures cleaning and washing, and painting for civil structures once in year. All the infrastructure must be maintained in good working condition through out the year so as to ensure uninterrupted water supply to all the habitation through out the year and repairs and replacement of damaged pipeline, valves etc., if found necessary it includes cost of materials and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems. The maintenance involves raw water raising main, gravity mains, pure water raising mains, maintaining the required discharge the quantum of water in each pipe including controlling all the values so that each village will get required designed quantum of water. Operation and maintenance of the water treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of PSS-KRISHI-10, Alum, Chlorine and other required necessary chemicals including replacement of sand/ filter media as per standards or established norms from time to time maintaining the quality of water as per the guide lines CPHEEO mannual and ISI specificatons inlcuding cost of testing of water at laboratory at reguler intrevals. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery other mechanical components of this scheme including electrical maintenance, covering all repairs/replacement of transformers /replacement of electrical cable / switch board / replacement of burnt parts of machinery, all above repair and maintenance will be carried out as per the direction of the Engineer in charge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide designed LPCD of drinking water to all the habitations of the Project villages. (Excluding Electrical energy charges). NOTE : Helpers /watch man/ valve man /Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at jackwell, WTP and pure water sump points. The G.P. or VWSSC/ Concerned Section officer of the Project should certify the stisfactorying fuctioning of the scheme and based on this payments will made to the contractor. The contractor should maintain a log book on the working of pumping machinary at Jackwell, WTP etc. The payment will be made by the Engineer-in-charge satisfactoryily report of every month end. (The GP Secretary and Section officer- incharge of WSS should give satisfactory report) Subject to conditions in Annexure-I) ---- with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges and all other incidental charges etc., for sucessful completion of work as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work
